content.title: Wurth M16x80-Grade 2 Hex Bolt, M16 x 2mm Thread, 80mm Length, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel, SAE J429 Grade 2
content.short_description: Wurth M16x80-Grade 2 hex head bolt, M16-2mm thread, 80mm length, zinc plated carbon steel, SAE J429 Grade 2 with 414 MPa tensile strength.
content.long_description:
The Wurth M16x80-Grade 2 is a hex head bolt manufactured from carbon steel to SAE J429 Grade 2 specifications. It features an M16 thread with a 2mm pitch and an overall length of 80mm, driven with a standard hex drive.

The bolt carries a zinc plated finish for corrosion resistance on the carbon steel substrate. As an SAE J429 Grade 2 fastener, it has a minimum tensile strength rating of 414 MPa, suitable for general-purpose structural and mechanical fastening applications where Grade 2 strength requirements apply.

Use this bolt where M16 x 2mm thread pitch and 80mm grip length are specified. Confirm mating nut and washer specifications align with M16-2mm thread and Grade 2 strength class prior to installation.
